title: The Home in the Valley
author: Emilie Flygare-Carlén
description: "The Home in the Valley" by Emilie Flygare-Carlén is a novel written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The story unfolds around Nanna, a modest and beautiful maiden living in a picturesque valley near Lake Wenner, whose life is marked by poverty and the challenges of social class distinctions.

authorInfo.bio: Emilie Flygare-Carlén (1807–1892) wrote The Home in the Valley. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
